bugs.title: Super Series - one AI response plans an ENTIRE series at once; tool renders each part sequentially as a queue of ordinary Stage B jobs
bugs.notes: SEED COMMIT (this commit). Plan of investigation/implementation: (1) Persist super_series flag on stage-a-request.json series block; new separate prompt template in pipeline/plan/prompt.py when super_series set (do not overload SERIES_DIRECTIVE). (2) Super-plan schema (top-level parts array, each shaped like per-part production.json + shared series_id) + strict validator in pipeline/plan/schema.py style; validate BEFORE slicing: tiling coverage, exactly one is_final. (3) Queue controller layer that slices super-plan into ordinary single-part jobs, synthesizing stage-a-request.json + production.json via bot/src/index.js nextPartRequestBody/nextPartJobId/manualSeriesContinuation (verify pipeline/plan/series.py derive_next_part has zero live callers - dead code). Sequential dispatch; on error HALT, notify via existing bot conventions; operator restarts failed part via existing manual restart; on complete auto-resume next part. (4) Empirically verify spawned parts pass pipeline/stage_b/series_reconcile.py with zero changes. (5) New super-series prompt carries SAME NARRATION DURATION CONTRACT + PICKING end_seconds rules per-part. (6) Publishing unchanged. Verification: full dry-run harness >=3 parts, halt/resume test, regression run of pipeline/tests + bot tests, new focused tests, ARCHITECTURE.md new section parallel to Series Mode docs.
